newsitem.title: UK: Oman debut Eurobond due in February/March - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Oman debut Eurobond due in February/March - dealers.

text.p: Oman's expected debut international bond issue could surface in February or early March, syndicate managers said on Friday.
A $150 million five-year Eurobond was expected, they said. J.P. Morgan was appointed lead manager for the issue last year.
"The deal will be for around $150 million with a five-year maturity. Roadshows will begin in the middle of February, with launch shortly after," a banker familiar with the deal said.
Last September, Oman raised $400 million in the international loan market. The seven-year transaction was increased from $300 million after being oversubscribed.
Oman is rated BBB-minus by Standard and Poor's.
At the time of the loan, a finance ministry official said the money would be used to fund development projects.
